about:
Intermountain Fuse Supply operates from South Salt Lake, Utah, supplying electrical components such as fuses, drives, and motor control products to customers across the United States. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm maintains a product lineup that includes fuses, ABB ACS880 drives, and a range of motors and control products. A notable service is its 24-hour emergency fuse service, intended to minimize downtime for customers facing urgent replacement needs. The company ships orders throughout the U.S. and offers a discount for first-time buyers.

While specific industry verticals are not listed, the product assortment suggests a focus on industrial electrical maintenance, repair, and operations. Customers likely include maintenance managers, electrical contractors, and facility operators who require rapid access to replacement fuses and drive systems.

Intermountain Fuse Supply emphasizes a commitment to quality, stating that it offers only best-in-class products without compromise. This positioning, combined with emergency service availability, aims to differentiate the company in the electrical distribution market.
